title: Concept: Gradle repository password written into the build script
description: build.gradle declares a repository credential written directly into the checked-in build script, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Everyone who can read the build script can publish or pull as that account, and the value also lands in build logs and caches.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: Everyone who can read the build script can publish or pull as that account, and the value also lands in build logs and caches.
